annotations.title: Agent memory, save: key value store for agents

description: Save a value (up to 8,000 characters of text or JSON) under a key in your own namespace, so an agent can remember facts, preferences or task state between runs. Overwrites an existing key; expires after 1 to 30 days (default 30). Values are kept until they expire (at most 30 days) or are deleted; reads anywhere may lag a write made elsewhere by up to a minute. Use to persist what an agent learned for a later call to memory_get. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Changes only what you saved in your own memory namespace; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

namespace.description: Your namespace: a secret of 16 to 128 letters, digits, - or _ that you choose and reuse. Anyone who knows it can read and write it, so treat it like a password; send it in a POST body to keep it out of URLs.

value.description: The text or JSON to save, up to 8,000 characters
